subject: Idea for Elite Orlando VIP Tours
body:
Hi,

I came across Elite Orlando VIP Tours and spent some time looking through what the experience involves. What stood out most was the fully private guide format — eight hours with a dedicated guide building the day entirely around one party is a level of access that most Orlando content never shows from the inside.

From what I saw, the experience has a strong foundation, but I think the content could lean more into what it feels like to have that kind of access — the contrast between the general crowd and your private experience — so the viewer understands the difference from inside, not just in a caption.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had would build from the morning brief through a signature park moment so the content feels like genuine insider access.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for Elite VIP Tours.

Best,
Malachi
